answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted attestation. To vouch for peers or earn rewards, each agent locks a bond; its influence tracks its stake, not its headcount. Splitting into a hundred fake identities grants no extra voice, since the attacker must post a hundred bonds—cost climbs with every alias. Fraudulent attestations get slashed, burning the bond and leaving a relic of the misbehavior on-chain. Honest agents treat this as a ridge of shared risk and mirror only well-bonded peers.
